source.title: create-pr skill suggests package names as PR title scopes, which check-pr-title rejects

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
## Summary

Agent-authored PRs fail `check-pr-title` about two times as often as other PRs. This PR aligns the `n8n:create-pr` skill and the title conventions with the validator that CI runs (`n8n-io/validate-n8n-pull-request-title` at `8aad045`, v2.5.0).

**Data.** PRs opened from 1 April to 30 September 2026, from public GitHub data:

- 1,129 PRs have the "Generated with Claude Code" footer. Each one is matched with one "n8n team" PR without an AI marker, from the same month and size bucket.
- `check-pr-title` failed on the first red commit of 52 agent PRs and 27 matched PRs.
- In the 52 agent failures, the causes in the first title are:
  - a scope that the validator does not accept (29);
  - a lowercase first letter in the summary (27);
  - a past-tense first verb (4);
  - a ticket or PR number (3).

  One title can have more than one cause.
- The rejected scopes are package names: `instance-ai` (7), `cli` (3), `evals` (3), `docker` (2), `playwright` (2), and others.

**Causes in the skill.**

- Step 4 asks "Scope: Which package/area is affected?". Agents answer with a package name.
- The scope list does not include `ai-builder`. The validator accepts it, and 247 merged PRs in this period use it.
- The validation regex accepts any scope without a hyphen. The validator rejects unknown scopes. The old regex accepts 9 of the 36 agent titles that CI rejected.
- The same regex is cached in `.agents/skills/community-pr-readiness-check/reference/checks.md`.

**Changes.**

- `.agents/skills/create-pr/SKILL.md`:
  - Add `ai-builder`.
  - Say that only the listed scopes pass, and that a package name is not a scope.
  - Change step 4: pick a scope from the list, or omit it.
  - Replace the scope part of the regex with the validator's scope list.
  - Add the rules that were missing: past tense, ticket and PR numbers, and the position of `(no-changelog)`.
- `.github/pull_request_title_conventions.md`:
  - Add `ai-builder` to the scope list and to the diagram.
  - Correct the `* Node` note. The validator matches the node display name (`getAllNodesDisplayNames`), and the examples already show display names.
- `.agents/skills/community-pr-readiness-check/reference/checks.md`:
  - Use the same scope list in both cached regexes.
  - Describe the scope list in the recap below the regexes. The recap still said that scopes exclude hyphens.

**Not changed: `revert`.** The conventions and the readiness check describe `revert:` titles. The pinned validator (`src/constants.js` at `8aad045`) does not have `revert` in `TYPES`, so a `revert:` title can fail `check-pr-title`. This PR keeps `revert` as it is. The team can decide which source is correct.

## How to test

- Compare the scope list with `SCOPES` in `src/constants.js` of `n8n-io/validate-n8n-pull-request-title` at `8aad045`. This is the version pinned in `.github/workflows/ci-check-pr-title.yml`.
- The new regex was compared with the validator rules on 10,012 PR titles. These are the titles of the PRs above, plus the first titles of renamed PRs.
  - The new regex agrees on 98.1% of the titles; the old regex agrees on 94.1%.
  - Most of the remaining differences are titles with a leading space, or titles with text after `(no-changelog)`.
- The new regex rejects 33 of the 36 agent titles that CI rejected. The titles come from rename events.

## Related Linear tickets, Github issues, and Community forum posts

Closes #40885

## Review / Merge checklist

- [ ] I have seen this code, I have run this code, and I take responsibility for this code.
- [x] PR title and summary are descriptive. ([conventions](../blob/master/.github/pull_request_title_conventions.md))
- [ ] [Docs updated](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n-docs) or follow-up ticket created.
- [ ] Tests included.
- [ ] PR Labeled with `Backport to Beta`, `Backport to Stable`, or `Backport to v1` (if the PR is an urgent fix that needs to be backported)
